coverageUnit: deduplicated scientific claim family, not individual sentence or independent hypothesis
coverageMeaning: Every identified scientific claim family across the declared primary surfaces has a stable ID. Repeated statements and numeric instances are grouped; original artifacts retain their exact numbers and qualifications. This denominator is finite and repository-specific, not the universe of clinical conditions or published evidence.

exclusions.reason: Generated or visual copies; canonical implementation and source documents are inventoried. Visual accessibility and output parity belong to H7.

exclusions.scope: tests/, examples/, fixture CSVs and Python parity/privacy tools
exclusions.reason: Software verification and synthetic examples of inventoried formulas or frozen study methods; not new empirical claims.

exclusions.scope: build, CI, CLI wrappers, Swift implementation, styles, release and design infrastructure
exclusions.reason: Execution/transport/presentation of inventoried methods, not additional scientific claim families. H7 owns implementation audit; pilot semantics are C30.

exclusions.scope: AGENTS, collaboration, contribution, governance, decision indexes, llms.txt, historical changelog and robustness program files
exclusions.reason: Routing, rules or summaries of inventoried claims; superseded historical statements are not promoted to current evidence.

exclusions.scope: External publications, their supplementary data and all possible diseases/intersections
exclusions.reason: H1 inventories repository representations only. H2 reviews primary content and currentness; H4 handles new dataset admission.

exclusions.scope: Private chat, email and participant-level records
exclusions.reason: Not public scientific source-of-truth artifacts; not published or copied by H1.

maintenance: A scientific formula, output, recommendation, empirical result or scope change must update claim IDs, surface mappings, matrix and H2 review queue. Retire IDs explicitly; never reuse them for different claims.
